info.title: OrderHub Update Service API
info.description: Version policy, Tauri updater responses, install eligibility and release administration. Management endpoints require a Bearer token and are only reachable from a controlled network.

200.description: Database and artifact store are usable

get.summary: Get the current channel policy and pinned release selection

parameters.name: currentVersion
parameters.description: SemVer reported by the native layer, never taken from the WebView.

parameters.name: X-Installation-ID
parameters.description: Random installation identifier persisted by the native layer.

409.description: Policy changed, revision conflict or release state conflict

503.description: Update service, policy or artifact store is unavailable

get.description: Returns 204 when no update is selected. The release_id and policy_revision must match the pinned policy context.

parameters.name: currentVersion
parameters.description: SemVer reported by the native layer, never taken from the WebView.

parameters.name: X-Installation-ID
parameters.description: Random installation identifier persisted by the native layer.

parameters.name: release_id
parameters.description: Release id pinned from the last policy response.

parameters.name: policy_revision
parameters.description: Revision pinned from the last policy response.

204.description: No update selected for this client

409.description: Policy changed, revision conflict or release state conflict

503.description: Update service, policy or artifact store is unavailable
